scope: Source-build linkage measurement for notice-scope classification. It is not a published-release binary receipt and makes no LGPL or complete-source-distribution conclusion.
observations: The GN alink edge lists Chromium Rust rlibs after Ninja implicit-input separator |, including temporal_capi, ICU Rust dependencies, and local_rustc_sysroot std/core/alloc/unwind/compiler_builtins rlibs.

The static-archive rule uses rspfile_content = ${in}; the Rust rlibs are not archive members. The measured member list contains no temporal_capi, temporal_rs, ICU Rust, or local Rust standard-library member names.

nm -g --defined-only finds zero C ABI temporal_rs_* definitions in librusty_v8.a; nm -u finds 307 temporal_rs_* C ABI references. C++ mangled symbols containing temporal_rs are wrapper/type references and are not C ABI definitions.
The checked-in normal denort closure includes cargo:temporal_capi@0.2.3 with actual-shipped four-target notice evidence.

classification.chromium_gn_rust_rlibs_and_sysroot: build/order-only inputs for this measured archive; do not promote them to a separate runtime notice component on this evidence alone
classification.temporal_capi_c_abi: external linkage remains required by librusty_v8.a and is represented by the actual denort Cargo closure component

limits: A final release binary link map may add or remove evidence. Reassess this boundary if GN rule semantics, RustyV8 pin, target, or final-link behavior changes.
